commits.headline: feat(tools): extract Ghidra defined strings and integrate into dossier and names
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
- Add tools/extract_ghidra_strings.py to extract 1,271 defined strings and
  function cross-references via Ghidra MCP REST API.
- Add config/strings.json and config/strings.tsv datasets.
- Update tools/dossier.py to display referenced string literals in CONTEXT.md
  under '## Referenced Strings'.
- Recover 12 function names (989snd, sceGs, sceDbc, MPEG) into
  config/names.tsv from retail debug strings and refresh include/names.h.

commits.headline: feat(re): recover CardState enum, memcard globals, and add Ghidra datamining tool
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
- Add CardState enum to include/structs.h recovered from retail pointer
  and string tables at 0x001A04D0 and 0x0015FE78 (byte-exact match).
- Recover gCardStateNames, gGameSaveData, gLevelSaveData symbol names in
  config/names.tsv and refresh include/names.h.
- Add tools/datamine_ghidra.py for on-demand local Ghidra scraping.
- Document discovered source file hierarchy, state machines, and Maya pipeline
